source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
Legends rules are official and meant for home games, store and club games, and campaigns. Their points are updated less often than Codex points, so bring them to a competitive Warhammer Event only with the organisers’ permission.

Legends units come in 2 kinds:

- Units dropped from your Codex that keep their own datasheets, with Legends points from the Munitorum Field Manual. Add them to your army like any Codex unit; where one datasheet covers several units, they are listed below.
- Legendary Proxies units, represented by another datasheet from your Codex. Field them as normal, using the datasheet listed for them and its points from the Munitorum Field Manual. Legends units sharing a datasheet also follow these rules.

During the mission sequence, make sure your opponent knows what each Legendary Proxies unit represents. Where a proxy’s size or base size causes an issue in battle (for example, it is **visible** when the real unit wouldn’t be), rule in the other player’s favour.
